settings.title: Superior Protection
settings.text: Keep your garage spotless all season long. Floor Defender effectively contains snow, slush, mud, oil, and chemicals, protecting your floors from winter mess. Cleaning is effortless — just drag it outside, hose it down, and let it air dry. It’s ready to go again in minutes.

settings.title: Quick and Effortless Setup
settings.text: No tools, no stress — simply roll out the mat, and it’s ready to protect your floor. Each Floor Defender includes Velcro pads for added stability, making it a convenient, low-maintenance solution for busy homeowners.

settings.title: Built to Last
settings.text: Crafted from durable 900GSM vinyl-coated fabric with a built-in Ethofoam barrier, Floor Defender is made for heavy use. Its tatami grain underside enhances traction and prevents shifting, ensuring long-lasting performance even under daily vehicle traffic.
